The Maharashtra Public Service Commission (MPSC) released the MPSC Result for the Prelims 2025 on 27th February 2026. The MPSC Rajyaseva Prelims Exam for the 2025 cycle was held on 9th November 2025. The candidates who have qualified the Prelims Exam are now eligible for the Mains Exam. Check the MPSC result release date, download link, mains exam dates, and other details from this article.

MPSC प्रिलिम्स निकाल २०२६ जाहीर: महाराष्ट्र लोकसेवा आयोगाने (MPSC) २७ फेब्रुवारी २०२६ रोजी प्रिलिम्स २०२५ चा MPSC निकाल जाहीर केला. २०२५ सायकलसाठी MPSC राज्यसेवा प्रिलिम्स परीक्षा ९ नोव्हेंबर २०२६ रोजी घेण्यात आली. प्रिलिम्स परीक्षेत उत्तीर्ण झालेले उमेदवार आता मुख्य परीक्षेसाठी पात्र आहेत. MPSC निकाल जाहीर होण्याची तारीख, डाउनलोड लिंक, मुख्य परीक्षेच्या तारखा आणि इतर तपशील या लेखातून तपासा.

MPSC Prelims Result 2026 Out @mpsc.gov.in

The MPSC Rajyaseva Prelims Result 2025 has been announced on the commission’s official website @mpsc.gov.in. It contains the district-wise list of candidates who have been shortlisted for the Mains Exam. Along with the result, the MPSC Prelims Cut Off Marks are also announced. If you had appeared for the exam, you can visit the MPSC website now to check your qualifying status.

एमपीएससी राजसेवा प्रिलिम्स २०२५ चा परिणाम आयोगाच्या अधिकृत वेबसाइट @mpsc.gov.in वर जाहीर करण्यात आला आहे. त्यात मुख्य परीक्षेसाठी निवडलेल्या उमेदवारांची जिल्हावार यादी आहे. परिणामसोबतच एमपीएससी प्रिलिम्सचे कट ऑफ मार्क्स देखील जाहीर केले आहेत. जर तुम्ही परीक्षेला बसला असाल, तर तुमची पात्रता स्थिती तपासण्यासाठी तुम्ही आता MPSC वेबसाइटला भेट देऊ शकता.

MPSC Result 2026: Key Highlights –
Exam Conducting Body Maharashtra Public Service Commission (MPSC)
Exam Name MPSC Maharashtra Rajyaseva Exam
MPSC Website mpsc.gov.in
Exam Stages Prelims, Mains, Interview
Prelims Date 9th November 2025
MPSC Prelims Result Release Date 27th February 2026

MPSC Prelims Result 2026 Download PDF

The MPSC Result PDF is now available on the official website of the Maharashtra Public Service Commission. Candidates can download the rollnumber-wise result by visiting the commission’s website or by clicking the direct link given below. No login credentials are required to view or download the result.

Download MPSC Prelims Result PDF (Rajyaseva 2025) 

Steps to Download MPSC Result 2026

The MPSC Result PDF can be downloaded easily from the commission’s official website @mpsc.gov.in. You can simply access the result from the ‘Latest Updates’ or ‘Results’ section of the MPSC website. The step-by-step process to download the result are explained below.

Step 1. Visit the MPSC website.

Step 2. Go to the ‘Latest Updates’ or ‘Results’ section.

Step 3. Click the MPSC Result download link.

Step 4. The MPSC Rajyaseva Result PDF 2026 will appear on your screen.

Step 5. Find your name or roll number in the result.

Step 6. Download and save the PDF for reference.

Details Mentioned on MPSC Result 2026

The MPSC Prelims Result is released in the form of a district-wise list containing the names and roll numbers of the candidates who have passed the Prelims, and are eligible for the Mains Exam. Here are some of the most important details mentioned on the MPSC Result PDF. You must carefully check these to avoid discrepancies later.

  • Exam date and stage
  • Names of the shortlisted candidates
  • Roll numbers of the shortlisted candidates
  • Instructions for the Mains
  • Category-wise MPSC Prelims Cut Off marks.

What’s Next After the MPSC Prelims Result 2026?

Now that the MPSC Result 2026 for the Prelims is announced, the shortlisted candidates will appear for the Mains Exam. The authorities will soon release the MPSC Rajyaseva Mains Notification, inviting applications for the same. After the mains exam, the candidates will be shortlisted for the interview. The final MPSC merit list will be prepared based on the marks scored by the candidates in the Mains and Interview stages.
